thread:
corin_pm: Quick standup for PredictEmbed GA closure: we need to finalize (1) publishable SLOs vs internal SLA text, (2) monitoring + pager thresholds, (3) docs + migration notes, (4) pricing bands + trial, and (5) rollout windows. Keep replies short.

isabel_eng: I'll own the SLO/SLA wording. Draft proposal: public SLO summary — p50 < 55ms, p95 < 200ms, monthly availability >= 99.95%. Internal SLA doc will include credits, exclusions, and measurement method.

nate_sre: For alerts: page if p95 > 250ms for 10m OR error-rate > 0.2% for 5m OR synthetic smoke fails 3/5. P0 if synthetic fails AND error-rate > 0.25%. Add cache-hit <60% for 10m as a warning. Owner: nate_sre.

dana_docs: Docs checklist: public quickstart (Py/JS) + minimal SLA summary, migration note for quantized fallback, troubleshooting runbook, and FAQ about dimension changes. I'll draft the quickstart and SLA summary. Need Grafana snippets and sample error payloads.

leo_finops: Pricing suggestion: 14-day trial with 20k tokens/day, then PAYG tiers: 0-1M $0.0008/token, 1M-5M $0.00055/token, >5M negotiated. Committed discount 20-30% depending on term. Need rough infra unit cost to finalize. Owner: leo_finops.

anya_releases: Rollout plan: weekday-only canary 3% -> 20% -> 60% -> 100% over 10 business days. Gate each step with 45m alert-free window + synthetic pass. I'll own automation and rollback.

oncall-bot: Reminder: set oncall rotation to ml-inference primary for 21 days; add backend-sre as secondary for 30 days. Verification scheduled at 6177777800.

isabel_eng: Grafana examples to drop into docs: ```
// p95 latency
SELECT percentile("latency_ms",95) FROM "predict_embed.requests" WHERE "model"='predict-embed-v1' AND $timeFilter
// error rate
SELECT sum("errors")/sum("requests") FROM "predict_embed.requests" WHERE "model"='predict-embed-v1' AND $timeFilter
```

dana_docs: Good — I'll include those. Sample error payloads?

isabel_eng: Use these short examples: { "error": "rate_limit_exceeded", "retry_after": 60 } and { "warning": "model_fallback", "note": "served smaller-dim vectors" }.

nate_sre: Ops note: add a synthetic endpoint that returns fixed anchors for cosine checks; smoke test should fail if mean cosine drops > 0.03 over 15m. I'll add runbook steps for mitigations.

leo_finops: I'll produce a provisional price sheet and a committed-discount template by EOD. Need infra to provide cost-per-1k-tokens estimate.

anya_releases: I'll wire synthetic checks into canary gating and push automation in 4 days. Also add a feature-flag to disable fallback per-account: header X-Prefer-Exact: true.

dana_docs: Docs action: PR skeleton with quickstart + SLA summary + migration note in 48h. I'll include examples for the X-Prefer-Exact header.

isabel_eng: Decision on fallback default: default allowed (better latency/cost); opt-out available via header/console. We'll document behaviour differences.

corin_pm: Action recap: isabel_eng -> SLA draft + measurement appendix (48h). nate_sre -> alert rules + synthetic endpoint + runbook (48h). dana_docs -> docs PR skeleton + FAQ (48h). leo_finops -> provisional pricing & trial plan (48h). anya_releases -> canary automation + gating (4 days). oncall-bot -> rota verify (scheduled). Lock numbers by EOD Friday unless objections.

leo_finops: No objections.

dana_docs: No objections.

isabel_eng: No objections.

nate_sre: No objections.

corin_pm: OK closing thread — I'll add these tasks to the GA checklist and ping owners tomorrow. If anything urgent, reopen here. :white_check_mark:
